brief: National emergency test in Australia and US tariffs dominate news; papers focus on AI usability and visualization.
news_summary: AusAlert test blares nationwide; US tariffs called 'unjustified'; Berlin Pride attack kills one; Netanyahu accuses NYC mayor of hate speech; Israel-West Bank violence escalates.

todays_image.caption: The Eastern Dwarf Siren, a silent amphibian, shares its name with the blaring AusAlert test siren, yet both signal a warning—one natural, one political.
